title: Storage driver factory threads the elicited backend answer through as driver.backend
asA: operator eliciting the storage backend at apply time
iWant: the shipped storage driver factory to accept the elicited answer and report it as driver.backend
soThat: a downstream operations panel and a review probe can read the shipped-backend value from the driver instance and cross-check against the elicited answer

acceptanceCriteria.description: createInMemoryDoStorage({backend: "sql"}) returns a driver whose .backend property equals "sql"; createInMemoryDoStorage({backend: "kv"}) returns a driver whose .backend property equals "kv"; createInMemoryDoStorage({}) defaults to "sql" per ADR-3403 recommendedDefault. The driver.backend field is present on every returned driver.
acceptanceCriteria.given: three factory calls with backend="sql", backend="kv" and no backend arg
acceptanceCriteria.then: each driver.backend reports the elicited answer or the default "sql"

acceptanceCriteria.description: F-6 SQL exposes query verbs: createInMemoryDoStorage({backend:"sql"}) returns a driver where typeof driver.query === "function" and typeof driver.exec === "function". createInMemoryDoStorage({backend:"kv"}) returns a driver where those properties are undefined; the KV surface is put/get/delete/list only. The verb set observable on the driver instance reflects the elicited backend.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a SQL driver and a KV driver from the factory
acceptanceCriteria.then: the SQL driver has .query and .exec as functions; the KV driver does not

acceptanceCriteria.description: F-6 KV refusal error kind: calling .query() on a KV driver throws DO_STORAGE_UNSUPPORTED_ON_KV naming the verb "query"; calling .exec() throws with naming "exec". The error message identifies the driver.backend value ("kv") so the caller can distinguish which backend refused.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a KV driver from the factory
acceptanceCriteria.then: the call throws DO_STORAGE_UNSUPPORTED_ON_KV naming the verb and the backend

acceptanceCriteria.description: Unknown backend refuses: createInMemoryDoStorage({backend:"redis"}) throws DO_STORAGE_UNKNOWN_BACKEND naming the offered value "redis"; the accepted values ("sql" and "kv") are listed in the message. No driver is returned.
acceptanceCriteria.then: the factory throws DO_STORAGE_UNKNOWN_BACKEND naming "redis" and listing "sql" and "kv"
